The Last Voyage of the SS Aurelia

name: The Last Voyage of the SS Aurelia
storyline: Atlantic Ocean, September 1936. Aboard the ocean liner SS Aurelia, shipping magnate Edward Blackwood is found dead in his first-class cabin. With no way off the ship, the investigation falls to the player, cast as the detective. Five suspects remain on board, each with their own account of the night. The player interrogates them in free-form conversation to uncover contradictions, apply pressure, and identify the murderer before the voyage ends.
summary: An interrogation mystery aboard a 1936 ocean liner. Five suspects. One murder. No dialogue options — every suspect is powered by AI and will remember every word, deflect every question, and only surrender their secrets under pressure. Four voyages. One truth. Break someone.
